title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: Shiny application, built golem package, exploring World Bank development indicators interactive country comparison, indicator comparison, population pyramid, ranked bar chart, correlation scatter, choropleth map views.

title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: installation instructions can found : https://cran.r-project.org/ ## install RStudio IDE (optional good idea) installation instructions can found : https://posit.co/downloads/ open RStudio type console: Note: install_github() may fail repository package data files tracked Git LFS GitHub source tarballs can contain LFS pointer files instead binary .rda data.

title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: Since data range 1960 onwards thousands indicators, use git large file storage. Since last update data file became larger 100mb git accept directly large files. result traditional installation may work. Use one following reliable options: Clone repository Git LFS enabled install locally: R: Download full repository regenerate package data locally running financial_indicators.R generate_package.R.
code: git lfs install git clone https://github.com/sedzinfo/golemworldbank.git devtools::install_local("golemworldbank")

title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: order update data: 1. run financial_indicators.R script 2. run generate_package.R script data updates almost yearly need frequent updates

title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: feature Shiny module rendered tab app: 📊 Country Comparison: plot one indicator’s value time one line per selected country 📈 Indicator Comparison: plot several indicators’ values time single country 👥 Pyramid: animated population pyramid age group sex, selected country, time 📉 Barplot: animated ranked bar chart one indicator per country, ranked value recent year 🔍 Scatterplot: animated bubble scatter correlating two indicators, bubble size population, colored region 🗺️ Map: animated choropleth map one indicator country, time 📋 Index: searchable table listing every indicator name available data

title: World Bank Indicators Explorer
text: package ships three lazy-loaded datasets, sourced World Bank Open Data: mfi — long-format indicator values, one row per country/indicator/year (Country Code, Country Name, Indicator Name, Year, value). mfi_population — long-format population counts five-year age group sex, used Pyramid tab. country_code — country/region reference metadata (region, income group, World Bank classifications), used join region info Scatterplot tab. Full column-level documentation available via ?mfi, ?mfi_population, ?country_code.
